question: Where can I get a list of public electric vehicle charging points in the United States, with location, operator, power (kW) and number of connectors?

answer.summary: The DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center (AFDC) Station Locator is the national official list. Its API (developer.nlr.gov) gives, per station location, coordinates, access, status, charging network and ports by level, and per charging unit the connector types, port counts and kW. On 2026-11-26 it held 84,725 public operating station locations with 267,448 charging ports (station_counts), plus 220 planned. 'Operator' is the network/provider field, not a separate CPO name, and kW is missing for part of Level 2 ports.
main_caveats: Count units differ: AFDC 'station' = location; station_counts.total and state tables for electric count charging ports; connector entries can exceed ports.
API defaults include private, planned and temporarily unavailable stations; filter access=public&status=E (planned = status=P with expected_date).
Operator is the charging network/provider (ev_network), not a CPO name; AFDC lists 17,948 Non-Networked ports (US and Canada) with no operator name.
California's CEC reports 98,251 public ports (data as of 2026-06-30, adds PlugShare and surveys) vs 70,178 in AFDC for CA on 2026-11-26: different sources, not equivalent.
The legacy developer.nrel.gov API host no longer resolves; use developer.nlr.gov. DEMO_KEY is rate-limited; the CSV form asks for name and email.
answer.confidence_reason: AFDC API, docs and counts pages were opened and tested on 2026-11-26 with a full Connecticut extract and a 97% national ports CSV read; operator limitation confirmed in field lists.

attributes.note: Lat/lon per station location with geocode_status accuracy; in CT 1,431 of 1,665 GPS, all inside the state bbox.
ev_network names the charging network per station and per charging unit; Non-Networked stations have none.
attributes.gap_note: No charge point operator (CPO) name field in the AFDC API/CSV field lists; 23 CFR 680.116(c) requires operator name only in per-network APIs for federally funded chargers.

attributes.note: power_kw per connector type within each charging unit (port level). DC fast filled; Level 2 often null.
attributes.gap_note: Nulls in source: CT 931 of 5,356 connector entries without kW; nationally 17,842 of 260,156 port rows read had no kW.

attributes.note: port_count per connector type per charging unit plus ports per level per station; unit is EVSE port, a port may list several connector types.

sources.name: Alternative Fueling Station Locator data (Alternative Fuel Stations API v1 and EV charging ports CSV)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Alternative Fuels Data Center (data managed by the National Laboratory of the Rockies, NLR)
sources.format: JSON, GeoJSON, CSV, XML (API); CSV via web download form
sources.license: Data Download Terms and Conditions: data 'may be used for any purpose whatsoever'; DOE/NLR names may not be used for endorsement
sources.summary: Official national list of EV charging station locations with coordinates, access, status, network, ports per level, and per charging unit the connector types, port counts and kW.
sources.coverage_note: API on 2026-11-26 (fuel_type=ELEC, country=US, access=public, status=E): 84,725 station locations and 267,448 charging ports; plus 220 planned and 1,473 temporarily unavailable public stations.
caveats: Counting units: station location vs port vs connector; station_counts.total is ports.
Operator = charging network (ev_network); no CPO name field; Non-Networked has none.
kW missing for part of Level 2 ports (about 21% in a CT test).

problems: Legacy host developer.nrel.gov does not resolve; the API answers at developer.nlr.gov.
DEMO_KEY rate limit observed at 10 requests (X-RateLimit-Limit: 10); a personal key requires signup.
The web CSV download form asks for first name, last name and email.
Nationwide ev-charging-units.csv exceeds 100 MB; only the first 100,000,000 bytes were read (260,156 port rows of 82,376 stations).

example.example_result: total_results 1665; station_counts ELEC total 4971 (ports). Record id 102092 'Danbury, CT - Tesla Supercharger', 7 Backus Ave, 41.379456,-73.4779, geocode 200-8, ev_network Tesla, ev_dc_fast_num 10; charging unit: TESLA power_kw 150.0 port_count 1.

if_unstructured.summary: Not needed for the core list: AFDC data are structured. Separate operator (CPO) names are only required in per-network APIs under 23 CFR 680.116(c) for federally funded chargers; no such API was tested, so no manual recipe is given.

local_terms.meaning: AFDC tool and database whose API and download hold the national charging station list.
API endpoint and filter that return EV charging stations on developer.nlr.gov.
AFDC's two counting units in its state tables.
Electric vehicle supply equipment port; the AFDC unit behind Level 1/Level 2/DC Fast counts.
Charging levels used as categories in AFDC and state counts.
Charge point operator; defined by AFDC but not a field in its data.
Federal standards for federally funded chargers, including 680.116(c) third-party data sharing.
Open Charge Point Interface, the protocol networks use to send data to AFDC and third parties.
